A '''sealsuit''' was used by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] exploring worlds with hostile [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]] and environmental conditions. They included a full [[Breath mask/Legends|face breather]] with a [[transglass]] viewplate, an internal analysis [[Computer/Legends|computer]] to monitor outside environmental conditions, and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] activated by a being's tongue.
